intent: Inspect and refactor PipelineConfiguration without changing its tabled contract or the frozen tests; keep it consistent with: Single wiring factory (@Configuration with @EnableConfigurationProperties(the TelemetryProperties instance method class)) and the ONLY registration mechanism: every bean below is a factory @Bean method, no unit self-registers. The @SpringBootApplication composition root already lives in the base package com.pulsestream.telemetry (scaffold, no second boot class); component scanning of the base package covers this class. Providers: StepLog, ValidationService, ReorderingService, AuditTrail (R2dbcAuditTrail), EventLogRepository (R2dbcEventLogRepository), EventBroadcast (SinkEventBroadcast), EventLogService, IntakeService, CorrelationWebFilter (installs the contextWrite correlation filter), TelemetryIngestController. telemetryPipeline provides the lifecycle-managed Disposable (destroyMethod dispose) that subscribes: stream() of the intake service -> map via validate() -> buffer by Duration.ofSeconds(reorderWindowSeconds) -> map via reorderWindow() -> flatMapIterable -> concatMap via append(); this is the consumer of every rule service.
